nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, admin checks and policy hooks throughout the protocol.
block.timestamp / now: used as signature expiry in Cheese.delegateBySig.
tx.origin: used as the only authorization gate in Comptroller.refreshCompSpeeds.
bool _notEntered: re-entrancy guard flag toggled by the nonReentrant modifier.
address admin: privileged administrator for CToken and Unitroller/Comptroller.
address implementation: target contract used for delegatecall in the delegators/delegates.
address comptrollerImplementation: active logic contract of the Unitroller proxy.
uint totalBorrows: outstanding borrows plus accrued interest for the market.
uint totalReserves: reserves accrued by interest and reserve factor.
uint totalSupply: total cTokens in circulation.
mapping(address=>uint) accountTokens: cToken balances per account.
mapping(address=>BorrowSnapshot) accountBorrows: principal and interest index per borrower.
uint borrowIndex: accumulator of interest earned since market opening.
uint accrualBlockNumber: last block at which interest was accrued (freshness check).
mapping(address=>uint) compAccrued: CHEESE accrued but not yet transferred to each user.
mapping(address=>uint96) balances: CHEESE token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint96)) allowances: CHEESE ERC-20 approvals.
mapping(address=>uint) nonces: signature replay protection for delegateBySig.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) transferAllowances: cToken approvals.
ComptrollerInterface comptroller: policy contract invoked by every cToken hook.
CToken.redeemFresh: computes redeem amounts, calls doTransferOut and then writes totalSupply/accountTokens.
CToken.borrowFresh: validates borrow, calls doTransferOut and then writes accountBorrows/totalBorrows.
CToken.transferTokens: internal cToken transfer with allowance and comptroller hooks.
CToken.seizeInternal: moves collateral from borrower to liquidator; seizer is msg.sender, not a parameter.
CToken.accrueInterest: public interest accrual updating accrualBlockNumber, borrowIndex, totalBorrows, totalReserves.
Admin function starting transfer of admin rights; guarded by msg.sender == admin.
Admin function finalizing admin transfer; guarded by msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
CErc20Delegator._setImplementation: admin-only pointer update followed by delegatecalls into the new implementation.
CErc20Delegator.delegateAndReturn: raw delegatecall of msg.data into implementation with assembly return forwarding.
CErc20Delegator.delegateTo: low-level delegatecall helper taking callee address and calldata.
Cheese.delegateBySig: signature based delegation using ecrecover, nonce and expiry.
Comptroller.refreshCompSpeeds: recomputes COMP/CHEESE speeds; gated only by msg.sender == tx.origin.
CToken.liquidateBorrowFresh: repays borrower debt and seizes collateral, possibly via external seize call.
CEther.doTransferOut: sends Ether with address.transfer after state effects.
CToken.mintFresh: performs doTransferIn then writes totalSupply/accountTokens for the minter.
CToken.repayBorrowFresh: performs doTransferIn then reduces accountBorrows/totalBorrows.
CErc20.doTransferIn: pulls underlying via transferFrom with assembly return-size handling and balance delta accounting.
CDaiDelegate.accrueInterest: calls PotLike.drip() on MakerDAO then super.accrueInterest().
Comptroller.transferComp: pushes CHEESE to a user and returns the un-transferred remainder.
External ERC-20 transfer out of underlying to a user-controlled address (reverts or returns based on non-standard return data).
Raw delegatecall into the stored implementation address; executes arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
External call to comptroller policy hooks (allowed/verify) during token operations.
ecrecover on a user-supplied ECDSA signature in delegateBySig.
address.transfer(amount) Ether send with fixed stipend to a user-controlled payable address.
CErc20Delegator payable fallback delegating any calldata to the implementation.
External CHEESE token transfer executed inside Comptroller.transferComp before compAccrued is finalized.
Manual uint96 checked arithmetic (add96/sub96) guarding balance and allowance updates.
External MakerDAO Pot/Vat state-changing calls (drip/join/exit/hope) re-entering as the cToken.
Cheese.transfer: ERC-20 transfer moving balances and votes.
Cheese.transferFrom: spender allowance consumption then balances update.
mintAmount parameter of CErc20.mint/mintInternal.
redeemTokensIn parameter controlling redeem size in redeemFresh.
borrowAmount parameter of borrowInternal/borrowFresh.
repayAmount parameter of repayBorrowFresh.
MintLocalVars.actualMintAmount storing the return value of doTransferIn.
Local totalReservesNew in _addReservesFresh committed to totalReserves.
Local amount variable inside Cheese._transferTokens used for add96/sub96 balance updates.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as spender/owner when reading and consuming transferAllowances.
msg.sender flows into redeemFresh as the redeemer that receives the external token transfer.
msg.sender flows into borrowFresh as the borrower receiving the external token transfer.
seize() passes msg.sender as the seizer token; a parameter here would be spoofable.
_setPendingAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == admin before repointing the delegate target.
delegateBySig recovers the signatory from caller-supplied signature data and delegates its votes.
refreshCompSpeeds is gated on msg.sender == tx.origin instead of a real authorization check.
transferComp sends CHEESE to a caller-derived user address before returning the residual amount.
mintInternal passes msg.sender as the minter.
repayBorrowInternal passes msg.sender as payer and borrower.
tx.origin is the sole authorization value used to allow speed refreshes.
now <= expiry makes signature validity depend on miner-controllable block timestamp.
nonces[signatory] is read and post-incremented to reject replayed signatures.
ecrecover result becomes the signatory used by delegateBySig.
The external token transfer runs before totalSupply is updated in redeemFresh.
The external token transfer runs before accountTokens[redeemer]/[borrower] are rewritten.
redeemFresh performs doTransferOut while the market still reflects pre-transfer balances.
borrowFresh performs doTransferOut before borrow accounting is committed.
totalBorrows is written only after the external transfer in borrowFresh.
accountBorrows[borrower] is written only after the external transfer.
totalSupply is decremented after doTransferOut in redeemFresh.
mintFresh calls doTransferIn on the underlying before writing supply state.
totalSupplyNew = totalSupply + mintTokens computed with addUInt.
totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows - actualRepayAmount computed with subUInt.
borrowerTokensNew/liquidatorTokensNew computed with subUInt and addUInt during seize.
transferAllowances[src][spender] is overwritten with allowanceNew after subUInt.
accountTokens[src] and accountTokens[dst] are updated in transferTokens.
transferTokens calls comptroller.transferAllowed before effects and transferVerify after.
mintFresh calls comptroller.mintAllowed and mintVerify external hooks.
redeemFresh calls comptroller.redeemAllowed and redeemVerify external hooks.
borrowFresh calls comptroller.borrowAllowed and borrowVerify external hooks.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls comptroller.liquidateBorrowAllowed/liquidateBorrowVerify hooks.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls seizeInternal in-kind or an external cTokenCollateral.seize during liquidation.
repayBorrowFresh calls comptroller.repayBorrowAllowed and repayBorrowVerify hooks.
transferTokens reads the comptroller state variable to issue policy hook calls.
accrualBlockNumber is advanced to currentBlockNumber after accrual.
borrowIndex = borrowIndexNew computed with mulScalarTruncateAddUInt on simpleInterestFactor.
totalBorrows = interestAccumulated + borrowsPrior via addUInt.
totalReserves updated via mulScalarTruncateAddUInt(reserveFactor, interest, reserves).
delegateTo executes a raw delegatecall to the provided callee with attacker/administrator supplied data.
The delegatecall target is the mutable implementation storage variable.
_setImplementation invokes delegateToImplementation/delegateTo after repointing implementation.
delegateAndReturn forwards msg.data through a delegatecall to implementation.
The payable fallback delegates arbitrary calldata into the implementation address.
CEther.doTransferOut sends Ether with to.transfer(amount).
borrowFresh reaches the Ether sending path in the CEther market.
redeemFresh reaches the Ether sending path in the CEther market.
CErc20.doTransferIn and doTransferOut form the pair of external underlying token interactions.
transferComp calls Cheese.transfer on an external token before the residual amount is stored.
compAccrued[user] is written from transferComp's return value after the external CHEESE transfer.
transferComp's result is stored back into compAccrued[user].
refreshCompSpeedsInternal recomputes compSpeeds which drives compAccrued distribution.
Cheese.transfer is the external callee that can re-enter the comptroller flywheel.
Cheese.transfer updates balances of source and destination.
transferFrom decrements allowances[src][spender] for non-infinite approvals.
transferFrom relies on sub96 for allowance and balance subtraction.
Cheese transfer path performs add96/sub96 on uint96 balances.
transferFrom eventually updates balances via _transferTokens.
CDaiDelegate.accrueInterest calls PotLike.drip() on an external MakerDAO contract while holding state.
CDaiDelegate.accrueInterest calls super.accrueInterest() after dripping the pot.
mintAmount parameter is passed into mintFresh and then doTransferIn.
redeemTokensIn parameter determines the redeem amount and supply burn in redeemFresh.
borrowAmount parameter is validated and then transferred out in borrowFresh.
repayAmount parameter is passed to doTransferIn and borrow-balance math.
actualMintAmount local receives the return value of doTransferIn in mintFresh.
totalReservesNew local is committed to totalReserves in _addReservesFresh.
The local amount variable drives add96/sub96 balance updates in _transferTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Pure input feeding mintFresh's transfer-in and share calculation; fold into the mintFresh function node.
Only used to size the redeem inside redeemFresh; fold into the redeemFresh function node.
Only used to validate and transfer out inside borrowFresh; fold into the borrowFresh function node.
Only consumed by repayBorrowFresh's transfer-in and borrow reduction; fold into repayBorrowFresh.
Temporary holder of doTransferIn's return value inside mintFresh; fold into mintFresh.
Internal arithmetic scratch value of Cheese._transferTokens; fold into the CHEESE transfer function node.
